zh-CN.title: 广场频道支持跟手滑动
items: 左右滑动时实时展示相邻频道，松手后平滑切换
各频道独立保留页面与滚动位置，相邻频道预加载首页，历史内容仍按需加载

en.title: Swipe between Square channels
items: Neighboring channels follow your swipe and settle smoothly when released
Each channel keeps its own page and scroll position; nearby feeds preload their first page while history loads on demand
